title: Second Brain — a local-first 3D YouTube library
description: A private, single-file static app that turns your own YouTube links and Google Takeout history into a 3D topic graph. Records and thumbnails stay in IndexedDB on the Mac; no account, no upload, no seeded corpus. Virtualized lists, local MiniSearch, 59 headless checks and an optional 100k capacity fixture.

release.note: The live site starts empty for every visitor by design. State-file commits after this snapshot trigger one more Pages run.

build.includes: Orientation and GitHub auth check; original 100k design and build; pivot to a local-first personal library after clarifying that 100k is a capacity target, not seeded content; removal of the synthetic corpus and shard loader; local oEmbed/thumbnail proxy; Takeout import with year/channel/single-topic grouping; empty-state onboarding; virtualized drawer and deferred MiniSearch; bookmarks/theme persistence; 59-check headless gate; 100k capacity benchmark (433 ms import); screenshots and OG card; documentation and provenance; skill repackaged and published.

operatorNotes.githubAuth: Reused the existing macOS Keychain credential through git's osxkeychain helper; no repeated credential prompts were triggered.
operatorNotes.noSyntheticData: No videos are shipped. benchmark/library-100k.json is generated on demand, gitignored and never fetched by the app.
operatorNotes.pivot: The first implementation shipped a 108k synthetic corpus. It was removed after the user clarified that 100k was a capacity target.
operatorNotes.originStorage: The library is bound to http://127.0.0.1:9000; a different host or port is a different IndexedDB.
